title: 方河 Fang He
subtitle: (Lake of the Hsien Fa picture) · Xiyang Lou

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: Plate XX: 线法墙 Xianfa Qiang and 方河 Fanghe
evidence.excerpt_other: Il faut remarquer à l'entrée de la rue, les deux grandes portes placées sur le premier plan.
evidence.summary: The east end of the ground; two rows of houses forming a street, leading the eye to far mountains, cut off from the park by a wide water; two rustic Tuscan gates in the foreground. Called fit for a stage set.

evidence.title: Engraving 20: 线法墙 Xianfa Qiang (湖东线法画) and 方河 Fanghe
evidence.excerpt_other: To produce an illusion of distance by means of the European idea of perspective with a single central vanishing point houses were partly modeled and partly painted on walls, five on each side, set like the wings of a stage,
evidence.summary: A European town seen across a lake: five walls a side narrowing towards the back, with a city wall and mountains painted on the back wall. Plate p.159: the ruin of those walls. Note Q35 has six a side.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 西洋楼
evidence.summary: The editors walk the strip from west to east with completion dates and plaques: 谐奇趣 1751, 养雀笼 1759, then the fountains and the perspective walls, with their mechanical details. They put the whole at about 2% of the gardens.

evidence.title: 西洋楼水法图
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 none shown
evidence.summary: Plan of the Xiyang Lou waterworks across its dozen sites; the record shows no shelf number. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.
